note: APScheduler 4.0.0a6 SQLAlchemyDataStore persisted schedules observed after the temporary '* * * * *' API schedule update was restored. Trigger blobs are pickled CronTrigger objects; cron fields decoded from the pickle payloads.
finding: API schedule updates for graph_snapshot/gnn_snapshot were accepted (HTTP 200) but never replaced the persisted APScheduler triggers: _register_schedule passes conflict_policy="replace" as a string while SQLAlchemyDataStore.add_schedule compares against the ConflictPolicy enum, so the IntegrityError replace branch never runs. The temporary every-minute cron therefore never fired; the store still shows the original 4-hour triggers.
